rationale: C03 is the only displayed earlier directive closely matching the child's specialized personnel-drafting language: both regulate permanent promotion of commissioned officers in named professional corps and express the rule by identifying particular corps or categories. Although C03 suspends examination requirements while the child imposes vacancy requirements, its sentence structure and personnel terminology plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template adapted to a different promotion restriction. C16 concerns personnel rights but uses different administrative machinery; C13 merely includes the Public Health Service within transportation regulations.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Commissioned officers of the Regular Corps of the Public Health Service ... shall be permanently promoted ... only if vacancies exist
shared_material.parent_excerpt: provisions of law requiring professional examinations for permanent promotion in the Regular Army of officers of the Medical, Dental, and Veterinary Corps
shared_material.explanation: Both use the distinctive formulation of regulating permanent promotion for officers in a regular uniformed service and then delimit the covered professional corps or categories.
